selection_policy: reachable source-defined computational functions; exclude main and I/O
code_summary: Boyer-Moore-Horspool-style string-search benchmark. init_search builds the 256-entry skip table and records the pattern; strsearch uses that table to scan a text and returns a matching address or NULL. The driver repeatedly searches fixed pattern pointers, creating a source-visible exact keyed-reuse opportunity in init_search. main is frozen to preserve the workload.
